title: chat-server test fails under realistic-demo-ids
description: chat_set_duplicate_direct_cleanup_destroy_failure_redacts_backend_display (crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/integration.rs:2442) seeds a phantom Direct chat with id "aaaa" and expects it to be lex-smaller than the newly created id. With --features realistic-demo-ids (included by --all-features) MemoryBackend mints bare hex ids from epoch nanos (e.g. 18e0190191f2eb33), which sort before "aaaa", so the handler keeps its own copy and never takes the cleanup-destroy path; notCreated[c0] is null. Reproduced on unmodified HEAD 466caf36: cargo test -p jmap-chat-server --features realistic-demo-ids --test integration chat_set_duplicate_direct_cleanup_destroy_failure. Default features pass (ids are chat000...). Fix: pick a phantom id that sorts first under both id schemes (e.g. "0").
